lesson: Default to interactive (terminal) clarification first; only fall back to a Jira pause-and-post when the operator times out. The interactive path saves 30-60 minutes of context-switch per ticket. Honour --no-clarifier-interactive when the run is unattended (CI / scheduled).
evidence: Interactive clarifier shipped in the supervisor; users adopted it for synchronous sessions immediately.

lesson: Emits BOTH a Markdown preview (for interactive stdin display) AND a Jira ADF payload (for pause-and-post). Posts to Jira only when auth_mode permits unattended writes (FULL_AUTO). One open question per ClarificationRequest entry; keep questions atomic so answers can be machine-parsed.
`clarifier` paused with: "Approve to post clarifier comment to Jira". Resolve this kind of ambiguity earlier (clarifier or analyser) so the DAG keeps moving.
evidence: clarifier returned `needs_input` in run for EDAEM-3725: 4 clarifying questions ready to post; awaiting approval.

lesson: Stakeholder ask 'add X to ARR' clarification questions (post-IA): (1) Which TIER? line / sku / subproduct / product / account×product. (2) Which CURRENCY VARIANT? usd_current / usd_hist / usd_actual (constant_currency / historical_currency / actual_currency tables). (3) ALL-TIME or POINT-IN-TIME? (all-time = boolor_agg rollup; point-in-time = as_was_date-keyed). (4) DASHBOARD CONSUMER? if Sigma/Tableau, add to a data_products view too. (5) GRAIN guard — does the new column require boolor_agg (boolean), sum (numeric), or array_unique_agg (array)? (6) DEFAULT VALUE when join misses?
evidence: eda-dbt-em PR walk 2026-06-25 (post-IA window: qa #449→#472, prod #459→#465); FLA upstream tree = 43 EM models + 15 cross-project + 2 external dims.

lesson: Slack thread side-channel has TWO prefixes: `task:` steers the run (skip/pause/cancel/status/debug/quarter-close) and `ans:` answers clarifier questions. Clarifier resolution order is terminal stdin -> Slack `ans:` -> Jira post. The `ans:` wait runs IN-PROCESS inside the live supervisor (poll_thread_messages), so no daemon/listener is needed.

In full_auto (--auto) the clarifier posts straight to Jira and returns OK -- it never returns NEEDS_INPUT, so the supervisor run-loop's clarifier-resolution block does NOT fire. To offer a Slack `ans:` window in full_auto you must intercept in _run_clarifier BEFORE clarifier.run(), using clarifier.build_clarification() to render questions without posting.
evidence: clarifier.run() branches on auth_mode==FULL_AUTO -> _post_comment; supervisor._run_clarifier now calls _try_slack_clarifier first in full_auto.

lesson: Bugs are NOT intake. Bug fixes flow separately from new-field intake and may deploy independently - this is the usual source of 'which Jira ticket?' confusion. When a request is a bug, do not route it through the intake/owner-required path.
